We are looking for one US-based closer for booked calls. The role starts with a paid two-week trial.</p> <p>The work</p> <ul> <li>Our sales are written-first. A prospect replies to our email, receives a free one-page written plan, and picks a call time in writing. You take those booked calls, return calls from prospects who phoned us, and rebook missed calls. No cold dialing and no lists.</li> <li>On each call you qualify, present our written fixed-fee offer (mid four figures to low five figures), confirm who signs, and ask for the decision. We send every agreement and payment link.</li> <li>You send a short written report after each call, the same day.</li> <li>Calls are in US business hours (Eastern Time). The work is remote.</li> </ul> <p>Who fits</p> <ul> <li>You are based in the United States.</li> <li>You have personally closed B2B service sales of US$5,000 or more with business owners or technical founders, on the phone.</li> <li>Experience selling to companies that pursue federal, SBIR or defense work is a strong plus.</li> <li>You are comfortable following a written call guide and firm rules: no promises about outcomes and no discounts.</li> <li>You do not currently write or sell federal proposal, white paper, SBIR or capture services for anyone else.</li> </ul> <p>How we screen and what we pay</p> <ol> <li>Your written answers to the three questions below.</li> <li>Finalists record a 3 to 5 minute drill on a short script we send. The drill is paid: US$40.</li> <li>Every drill is scored on the same written scorecard.</li> <li>The strongest candidates are offered a paid two-week trial: US$45 an hour, up to 10 hours a week, plus 15% of the fees we actually collect on deals you close. The exact terms are in a written agreement you see before you start.</li> <li>The role after the trial depends on results. We do not promise a drill, a trial, a hire, or any number of hours, calls, deals or earnings. Call volume is modest today.</li> </ol> <p>Part-time to start; the best performer moves to more hours as booked calls grow.</p> <p>To apply, email these three answers. Everything is in writing.</p> <ol> <li>Describe one B2B service sale of US$5,000 or more that you personally closed: what the service was, the price, and who signed.</li> <li>Your city and state, and the hours you could work each week between 9 am and 6 pm Eastern Time.</li> <li>A prospect says, "Send me something and I'll think about it." What do you say next?
